events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $2.73 (model confidence 0.82)
events.body:
The trace settles the RD-1 element: one off-route segment exists (F3), 09:47–09:53, 3.83 km driven against 1.89 km of optimal route, +1.94 km [F3][RD-1]. The only chat message before the segment started (09:47:50) is F7 at 09:35, and it names a pickup point ("kerb outside Mandarin Gallery") — a locator, not a route instruction, not a named road, and not a stop request; the chat record is complete (1 message, all timestamped) [F7][F8]. So there is no rider message before the segment agreeing to any route, which puts the segment under the "no consent before the segment" branch, not a general or named-road authorisation [RD-5]. The driver's post-trip statement that he followed his GPS and "nothing wrong with the fare" is a claim made after the fact, not rider consent, and GPS rerouting by itself is not a reasonable cause: the trace marks RD-4(a) as failed (no qualifying incident) and the two speed-band facts (F10, F11) are band 4, 30–39 km/h, which is neither a traffic incident nor an RD-4(b) band 1–2 condition, so no exemption arises on that ground either [F9][F10][F11][F12][RD-4]. I therefore find segment F3 counts as a non-exempt off-route segment [F3][RD-2].

The trip is a RydeTAXI metered trip (charged $29.11 total, distance $18.50 for 13.12 km, distance fare ÷ distance km = $1.4101/km), so the metered-distance branch of RD-2 applies and extra kilometres billed are refundable [F4][F6][RD-2]. The trace advises using $1.4101/km rather than the bundled excess figure, so the refund is computed on the segment's own extra km: 1.94 km × $1.4101/km = $2.7356, rounded to $2.73 [F3][F4][RD-2]. It is a RydeTAXI trip, so the ride-hailing cancellation/waiting branches (NS-0, NS-1 to NS-6) do not apply to this dispute; no waiting fee was charged in any event ($0.00), and the $1.47 platform fee is a published charge, so no FARE-1 item is refundable [F6][NS-0][FARE-1].

Account action: the driver's profile shows 1 upheld dispute in 90 days, but with route disputes upheld = 0, so the RD-6 "repeated route breach" condition (route_disputes_upheld_90d ≥ 1) is not met and no flag_account is added; RD-6 also bars using profile facts to establish the breach itself, which I have not done [F15][RD-6].

Please follow the route shown to you unless the rider asks otherwise.
